text:
Jordan Grimmer-Tufik the clerk on our case file has confirmed receipt of the appeal. Noting the clerk’s reply in English:

The office is currently closed, but once it opens, the appeal will be transferred to the office manager and reviewed by her.

Does that mean we can continue to wait for an appeal outcome and hold off on the deposit payment for the time being with our file intact?

Also, Jordan, do you have an idea on the average waiting time before PIBA informs their decision on an appeal?
